newsitem.title: USA: CME shifts date for Mexican peso option strike cut.
newsitem.headline: CME shifts date for Mexican peso option strike cut.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) has shifted to June 9 from May 19 the effective date for halving the strike price intervals in its options on Mexican peso futures, a CME spokesman said Friday.
Other details of the change, which the CME announced in a members' notice Thursday, remain the same, she said.
CME said it will list the futures-options at strike price intervals of $0.00125 per New Mexican peso.
Currently, peso futures-options exercise prices are listed at $0.0025 intervals. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
